chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Kyiv, 2012: the Euro final, Spain against Italy. Jordi Alba passes to Xavi in his own half... and keeps running! Xavi slides the ball through. Alba finishes with his left foot. Two nil to Spain!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Alba sprints fifty metres, into the space behind the defence. The pass goes between two defenders, right into his path.

chapters.label: The finish
chapters.text: One touch to control it, then he slots it past Gianluigi Buffon. His first goal for Spain!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: when a teammate looks up, sprint into the space behind the defence!
